data.exact_reserve_text: The GAAP calendar year result reflects the application of a prudent reserving policy, the outcome of a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business and reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of the liabilities relating to the 2017 and prior years of account of Syndicate 1969 into Syndicate 1994 via RITC, contributing to the inherited reserves.
Transfer of the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 3330 into Syndicate 1994 via RITC, following a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's 2021 results reflect a material strengthening of prior year gross claims reserves, driven by a full reserving review (including the Syndicate 3330 book) and prudential reserving actions. The gross claims development triangle shows aggregate adverse movement of approximately GBP 27.9m across older underwriting years (2012-2018), with particular pressure on non-marine liability/third-party liability lines. The movements follow the reinsurance-to-close transfers into the syndicate which brought legacy reserves on-board.
raw_causal_phrases: full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business
reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No prior-year comparative 'claims outstanding' (opening reserves) is shown on the balance sheet (first year of syndicate presentation), so opening_reserves is null. Prior year development was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (Gross incurred claims rows) as a fallback; RITC activity (transfer of Syndicate 1969 and 3330 reserves into 1994) is present and may distort development patterns. The report gives narrative that reserves were strengthened following a full reserving review; a gross movement of +GBP 27.9m (adverse/strengthening) was derived from the triangle. Prior_year_development_pct could not be calculated because an opening gross claims outstanding (1 Jan comparative) is not presented.
